title: LoReRNA pipeline parameters
description: Long-read RNA-seq: MisER -> IsoQuant -> oarfish -> swish (fishpond)

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

samplesheet.description: Path to comma-separated file describing the input samples.
samplesheet.help_text: Requires the columns 'sample_name', 'condition' and 'bam'. Optional columns 'pair' (activates paired Wilcoxon in swish) and 'batch' (activates batch-aware swish).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

publish_mode.description: Nextflow publishDir mode used for all published results.
publish_mode.help_text: Use 'copy' for production runs so results survive `nextflow clean`. 'symlink' is faster but results break if the work directory is removed.

reference_fasta.description: Genome FASTA file (e.g. GRCh38 primary assembly).

reference_bed12.description: Annotation in BED12 format, used by MisER for splice-junction correction.

reference_gtf.description: Annotation GTF/GFF for IsoQuant. Provide either this or --reference_db, not both.

reference_db.description: Pre-built gffutils database for IsoQuant. Provide either this or --reference_gtf, not both.
reference_db.help_text: Using a pre-built gffutils .db avoids IsoQuant rebuilding the database on every run.

miser_scratch_root.description: Node-local scratch root used by MisER. Defaults to /scratch0 when unset.
miser_scratch_root.help_text: MisER copies the input BAM to node-local scratch to avoid saturating shared NFS. On non-SGE sites set this to your scheduler's local scratch path (e.g. $TMPDIR).

miser_qc_min_support.description: Minimum supporting reads for a rescued micro-exon to be reported.

miser_qc_all_events.description: Include events that did not pass MisER's realn_flag filter in the exon catalog.

isoquant_exe.description: IsoQuant executable name (renamed from isoquant.py in IsoQuant 3.13.0).

isoquant_complete_genedb.description: Pass --complete_genedb (appropriate for complete annotations such as GENCODE/Ensembl).

seq_tech.description: Sequencing technology; controls the internal minimap2 preset.

oarfish_num_bootstraps.description: Bootstrap replicates for inferential uncertainty (required by swish DTU).

oarfish_filter_group.description: oarfish alignment filter group. 'no-filters' lets EM handle multi-mappers probabilistically.

swish_condition_a.description: Reference condition (denominator), must match a value in the samplesheet 'condition' column.

swish_condition_b.description: Comparison condition (numerator), must match a value in the samplesheet 'condition' column.

swish_min_count.description: Minimum count for a feature to be retained before testing.

swish_min_n.description: Minimum number of samples meeting min_count.

swish_nperms.description: Number of permutations for the swish test.

swish_top_n.description: Number of top features shown in publication heatmaps.

container_options.title: Container options
container_options.description: Container images used by the pipeline.

container_lorerna.description: Container providing samtools, IsoQuant, oarfish, MultiQC and R.

container_miser.description: Container providing MisER, pysam and samtools.

tool_executables.title: Tool executables
tool_executables.description: Executable names, overridable for unusual environments.
